constraints.quantity: Hg1-xCdxTe quantum-well Cd fraction bracketing the observed transition neighborhood
allowed_use: select or simulate discrete near-critical design points
stratify future specimens by composition and thickness
prohibited_use: interpret as a confidence interval for the critical composition
interpret as a local composition distribution
transfer directly to bulk HgCdTe criticality

constraints.quantity: thicknesses of the two boundary-candidate quantum wells
constraints.measurement_note: XRR precision reported as approximately plus or minus one atomic layer
allowed_use: define specimen-selection and sensitivity-analysis design points
prohibited_use: treat as a measured thickness-fluctuation distribution
infer lateral thickness covariance

constraints.quantity: k.p Landau-level Gaussian occupation broadening coefficient
prohibited_use: use as an STS or optical instrument response
use as an experimentally measured linewidth

constraints.quantity: reported whole-map Cd-fraction standard deviation for the CdZnTe-substrate specimen
prohibited_use: set nanoscale random-mass variance
infer a correlation length
treat the 100 um aperture as a measured PSF

constraints.quantity: reported Cd-fraction standard deviation in the central 20 x 20 mm region of the CdTe/Si specimen
prohibited_use: set a local alloy-disorder prior
infer nanoscale covariance

constraints.quantity: reported Cd-fraction standard deviation over the full CdTe/Si scan
allowed_use: severe nonstationary edge-to-center drift stress case
prohibited_use: set local random-mass amplitude
pool with the central-region sigma as independent samples

constraints.quantity: derived full-map to central-region reported sigma ratio for the CdTe/Si specimen
prohibited_use: interpret as scale-dependent stochastic variance without raw coordinates and a measured PSF

allowed_use: require higher-resolution composition profiles to be convolved before comparison
prohibited_use: infer lateral composition covariance
assign a 580 nm disorder correlation length
reuse as a universal instrument PSF

allowed_use: demonstrate why nominal spot size must not replace measured response
prohibited_use: apply as a correction factor to unrelated instruments

constraints.quantity: flat-region zero-current plateau excess above the reported bulk gap
allowed_use: require electrostatic and transport checks before gap inference
prohibited_use: subtract universally from HgCdTe spectra
treat the plateau as the bulk gap
interpret as an energy-resolution width

constraints.quantity: derived apparent plateau to reported bulk-gap ratio
prohibited_use: use as a universal HgCdTe TIBB correction

allowed_use: require bias-polarity controls before interpreting STM topography
prohibited_use: treat single-bias topography as surface geometry
convert pit contrast directly into composition

specimen_selection: do not collapse QW criticality into the bulk critical composition
spatial_analysis: measure or independently calibrate the spatial response
detrend large-scale drift before estimating stationary covariance
spectroscopy: record measurement temperature and modulation settings
measure or bound the effective energy-resolution kernel
repeat topography and spectroscopy under bias-polarity controls
separate flat regions, pits, and protrusions
model or bound tip-induced band bending and transport limitation

unsupported_quantities: probability distribution for local composition or mass
stop_rules: Do not combine constraints from different papers into one specimen record.
Do not assign a probability distribution where the source only supplies a design point or stress case.
Do not treat Chang wafer-scale sigma values as local random-mass variance.
Do not treat the Biquard depth-response kernel as a lateral correlation length.
Do not treat Zha apparent gaps or topography as calibrated local DOS or geometry.
Do not reactivate R05 or authorize a larger random-mass simulation from this package.
